newsitem.title: BRAZIL: Brazil shares end higher on strong capital flows.
newsitem.headline: Brazil shares end higher on strong capital flows.

text.p: Brazilian shares closed strong Friday on high volume boosted by increased foreign and domestic buy orders, brokers said.

The Bovespa index of the 48 most traded stocks ended up 2.05 percent at 11,334 points. Market turnover totalled a hefty 1.05 billion reais ($990.5 million), above the market's recent daily average of $700-$800 million.
"It is just the demand and offer rule. Prices rise as we have more investors entering the market, but the volume of stocks available remain the same," a senior trader said.
